title: Causes of Crime Adventure
welcome_lead: Why do some people break the law? Theories galore. 🕵️
meta_desc: Crime & Society Adventure 2 — KS3 Sociology on causes of crime.
final_note: You met theories of crime, from biology to inequality.

concepts.def: Pressure when goals seem out of reach

walkthroughs.body_html:
Crime has many causes:

  • Inequality — poverty pushes some to crime.
  • Peer pressure — friends in gangs.
  • Poor schooling.
  • Family breakdown.
  • Addiction.

Sociologist Robert Merton said: when society sets big goals (money, fame) but blocks the legal path, some choose crime to reach them.

That's strain theory.

Ways to prevent crime:

  • Good schools and youth clubs.
  • Jobs and apprenticeships.
  • Mental health support.
  • Tackling poverty.

Prison is the end — prevention is cheaper. 💷
